SELECT CASE WHEN
  (SELECT md5(content) FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) = $hk$10c3d6fd538d2abf779f1cfa71e874a1$hk$
  AND (SELECT content FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) LIKE '%، ' || substring((SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis) from 'عبارة "([^"]+)"') || '.'
  AND (SELECT (length(content) - length(replace(content, substring((SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis) from 'عبارة "([^"]+)"'), ''))) / length(substring((SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis) from 'عبارة "([^"]+)"')) FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) = 1
  AND (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-7f8f53c1b08ed35c951275ed$hk$ AND u.article_number = 25 AND NOT u.is_bis) LIKE '%أُلغيت هذه المادة%م/191%'
  AND (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 217 AND NOT u.is_bis) LIKE '%أُلغيت هذه المادة%م/191%'
  AND (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-7f8f53c1b08ed35c951275ed$hk$ AND u.article_number = 24 AND NOT u.is_bis) IS NULL
  AND (SELECT body FROM boe.unit WHERE law_id = $hk$boe26-18804cb8b1d8b64f98293028$hk$ AND body LIKE '%يُعمل بهذا النظام بعد مضي (مائة وثمانين) يومًا من تاريخ نشره%') IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT published_gregorian FROM boe.law WHERE id = $hk$boe26-18804cb8b1d8b64f98293028$hk$) IS NOT NULL
  AND (SELECT "articleNumber" FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpzcuxfd07l2vtrkarl3462j$hk$) = 25
  AND (SELECT "articleNumber" FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpzcuxfd07l1vtrks2pni2ym$hk$) = 24
  AND (SELECT "articleNumber" FROM legal_articles WHERE id = $hk$cmpwibrek01ytnxffw28acmmf$hk$) = 217
  THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf39-99fc134312428063e54ac0b8$hk$, 'unit', $hk$cmpzcuxfd07l2vtrkarl3462j$hk$, 'ملغاة', $hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/191 وتاريخ 1444/11/29هـ$hk$, (SELECT l.url FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-7f8f53c1b08ed35c951275ed$hk$), (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-7f8f53c1b08ed35c951275ed$hk$ AND u.article_number = 25 AND NOT u.is_bis), 'rule', $hk$rule-item3-2026-10-24$hk$, now(), NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification WHERE id = $hk$vf39-99fc134312428063e54ac0b8$hk$)

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf39-35fa9f40dd3de2ec7760a82b$hk$, 'unit', $hk$cmpwibrek01ytnxffw28acmmf$hk$, 'ملغاة', $hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/191 وتاريخ 1444/11/29هـ$hk$, (SELECT l.url FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$), (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 217 AND NOT u.is_bis), 'rule', $hk$rule-item3-2026-10-24$hk$, now(), NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification WHERE id = $hk$vf39-35fa9f40dd3de2ec7760a82b$hk$)

INSERT INTO unit_version (id, unit_id, body, valid_from, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, created_at)
SELECT $hk$uv39-2af433307fac0ba094bad62d$hk$, a.id, replace(a.content, '، ' || substring((SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis) from 'عبارة "([^"]+)"'), ''), (SELECT (l.published_gregorian + 180)::timestamptz FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-18804cb8b1d8b64f98293028$hk$), $hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/191 وتاريخ 1444/11/29هـ$hk$, (SELECT l.url FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$), (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis), now()
FROM legal_articles a WHERE a.id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$ AND md5(a.content) = $hk$10c3d6fd538d2abf779f1cfa71e874a1$hk$ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unit_version WHERE id = $hk$uv39-2af433307fac0ba094bad62d$hk$)

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf39-5e4b5e4c240813196c5f8371$hk$, 'unit', $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$, 'ساري', $hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/191 وتاريخ 1444/11/29هـ$hk$, (SELECT l.url FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$), (SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis), 'rule', $hk$rule-item3-2026-10-24$hk$, now(), NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification WHERE id = $hk$vf39-5e4b5e4c240813196c5f8371$hk$)

INSERT INTO verification (id, object_type, object_id, verified_status, evidence_instrument, evidence_url, evidence_quote, method, verified_by, verified_at, supersedes_verification_id)
SELECT $hk$vf39-15810e831bb827e192f9b44a$hk$, 'unit', $hk$cmpzcuxfd07l1vtrks2pni2ym$hk$, 'ساري', $hk$مرسوم ملكي رقم م/191 وتاريخ 1444/11/29هـ$hk$, (SELECT l.url FROM boe.law l WHERE l.id = $hk$boe26-7f8f53c1b08ed35c951275ed$hk$), aa.summary, 'manual', $hk$rule-item3-2026-10-24$hk$, now(), NULL
FROM article_amendments aa WHERE aa."articleId" = $hk$cmpzcuxfd07l1vtrks2pni2ym$hk$ AND aa."changeType" = 'repealed' AND aa.summary LIKE '%المادة (الخامسة والعشرون) من نظام المحاماة%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM verification WHERE id = $hk$vf39-15810e831bb827e192f9b44a$hk$)

SELECT CASE WHEN
  (SELECT count(*) FROM verification WHERE verified_by = $hk$rule-item3-2026-10-24$hk$) = 4
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM unit_version WHERE unit_id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) = 1
  AND (SELECT body FROM unit_version WHERE unit_id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) LIKE '%تحت يد حائزه.'
  AND (SELECT length(a.content) - length(v.body) FROM legal_articles a JOIN unit_version v ON v.unit_id = a.id WHERE a.id = $hk$cmpwibpf901yhnxffsxmllv7m$hk$) = length(substring((SELECT n.note_text FROM boe.amendment_note n JOIN boe.unit u ON u.law_id = n.law_id AND u.seq = n.unit_seq WHERE n.law_id = $hk$boe26-eefebbe684b518fb578331ef$hk$ AND u.article_number = 211 AND NOT u.is_bis) from 'عبارة "([^"]+)"')) + 2
  THEN 'ok' ELSE (1/(SELECT count(*) FROM legal_systems WHERE false))::text END
